availability_note: previous_day1 is the forecast run issued the day before the valid time: available no later than valid_time - 24h. Exact issue timestamps are not published by the endpoint, so the pin records the lead-time bound, never an exact issue time. Every feature used by the screen is therefore knowable before first pitch by at least the declared bound.
barred: Observed weather actuals (archive/reanalysis observations) were never pulled and are barred as a leak: a model priced on the day may only see the forecast, not the day's realized weather.
coverage_findings: temperature_2m previous_day1 is fully populated for all pulled seasons (6,240/6,240 hours per venue-season).

wind_speed_10m, wind_direction_10m and precipitation previous_day1 are ALL-NULL for the 2022 and 2023 seasons and fully populated for 2024 and 2025: the Previous Runs archive serves the wind/precipitation forecast components only from 2024 onward.

Consequence under the declared NO_DATA handling: the weather feature (which requires the wind-out component and the precipitation indicator) exists only for 2024-2025 games. The weather term is inactive in the 2023 and 2024 folds (their fit windows contain only pre-2024 games) and is fitted on 1,763 fit-window rows for the 2025 fold.
Unmapped venues: Gocheok Sky Dome (2 games) and Tokyo Dome (2 games) are not in the venue table; both are domed stadiums. Their games take the NO_DATA -> neutral treatment and are counted here.
Roof parks (fixed or retractable, per the pull table) are weather-neutral by rule even where a series was pulled.
grain: hourly, UTC; the screen reads the hour containing the StatsAPI UTC first pitch
handling_declared: Missing feature (roof, unmapped, missing hour, or pre-2024 wind/precip gap) => NO_DATA => weather log-multiplier 0 (neutral). Weather coefficients are fitted only when >= 200 fit-window games carry features; otherwise the term stays off for that fold. No actuals substitution, ever.
input: first-pitch weather (design section 3, input 4; step B of the design's build order)

manifest.contents: per-pull file name, venue, season, sha256 of the raw response, hourly row count

pull_grain: one pull per (venue, season) for every venue hosting a game in 2022-2025 per the StatsAPI substrate (venue table with lat/lon, CF bearing, roof flag lives in pull_weather_previous_runs.py)
source: Open-Meteo Previous Runs API (archive of model forecast runs)
